# mergewf_skill_configuration (Resource)

Manages display fields, publication, and reach for an existing authored skill. Upload the bundle before adopting it with its slug. Destroy leaves the skill unchanged. Import using its slug. Do not use this resource for Merge-managed global skill enablement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergewf_skill_configuration" "example" {
  slug         = "example-skill"
  name         = "Example skill"
  description  = "An existing uploaded skill managed by Terraform"
  is_active    = true
  access_scope = "ORG"
  group_ids    = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) API field `slug`. Minimum length: 1.

### Optional

- `access_scope` (String) API field `access_scope`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Who an organization skill reaches: everyone, some Groups, or only its author. Allowed values: `ORG`, `GROUP`, `PERSONAL`.
- `description` (String) API field `description`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Maximum length: 1024.
- `group_ids` (List of String) API field `group_ids`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection.
- `is_active` (Boolean) API field `is_active`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection.
- `name` (String) API field `name`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 255.
- `referenced_connectors` (List of String) API field `referenced_connectors`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity. See the resource description for its import format.
- `result_json` (String) Complete API response encoded as JSON. Use jsondecode to access additional response fields. Stored in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergewf_skill_configuration.example SKILL_SLUG
```
